description: A glossy black bird statuette stands on a desk beside a lit green-shaded banker's lamp. A man in a fedora and trench coat stands in the dim background, with cigarette smoke curling up and venetian-blind shadows across the wall. A black rotary telephone and an ashtray sit at right, and papers lie on the left. The scene is an oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge with no border.
